# Zehn

> Zehn is an audio microlearning app with 2398+ book summaries in English, Russian, Tajik, and more. Each summary is 15–30 minutes of professionally narrated audio with live subtitles, chapter previews, and Ask AI.

## App

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759160035): Download Zehn on iOS
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audiobook.zehn): Download Zehn on Android

## Book Catalog

- [All Books](https://thezehnapp.com/books): Browse all 2398+ audio book summaries
